non_claims: A three-job sequential artifact relay is not atomic multi-host concurrency or cross-run persistence.
Local SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE does not provide cross-cloud distributed consensus.
Hash chaining without independent signatures does not prevent a privileged database writer from rewriting both events and hashes.
CI success proves bounded synthetic software mechanics, not performance gain or general intelligence.
Repository workflows remain temporary GitHub-hosted resources, not permanent user-controlled VM leases.
The current 2-worker admission ceiling is per relay queue; it is not a global limit on all JANUS Actions workflows.
No authenticated production external provider dispatcher has been connected.
No true blind final model evaluation, CAS champion promotion, full consumer ACK or production rollback established.
next_gates: Independent durable cross-run state custody with exact-head CAS and external witness
Multi-host fencing, crashed worker reconciliation, signed provider outcome and idempotent resume
Owner-authorized provider drivers with permission, workload and free-tier cost gates, zero quota evasion
Explicit mapping of typed task envelopes to approved development, evaluation or owner-hosted compute executors
